title: RepoMesh External Worker Enrollment v1
description: Non-secret binding a Room-Native Coding Agent Bridge instance needs to serve one AgentTeams external worker. Credential fields are opaque references resolved by the local credential resolver at runtime; secret values never appear in this document.

workerName.description: AgentTeams Worker resource name. The referenced Worker must have containerManaged: false.

matrixUserId.description: Fully qualified Matrix user id of the worker identity. Used for mention detection and sender binding; the access token is NOT part of this document.

allowedRoomIds.description: Rooms the Bridge may read from and post to. Events from any other room are ignored; invites outside this list are not auto-joined.

repomeshEndpoint.description: Base URL of the RepoMesh control plane used for task validation and governed execution.

codingProfile.description: Runner profile id driving the local CLI session. Exactly one per enrollment.

credentialRefs.description: Opaque references handed to the local credential resolver. A ref names where a secret lives (keyring entry, env var name, file path); it is never the secret itself.

displayName.description: Optional human-facing name used in room messages. Defaults to workerName.

credentialRef.description: Opaque locator understood by the local credential resolver. Must not contain the secret value.
